notes: DP-1529: Zach approves leaving the RFC 931 ident lookup unported. With the immortal `ident` toggle on, C prints "Please wait." on the next connection while it queries the client's identd on port 113 (src/ident.c:60-68); the port keeps the toggle's C command bytes but never connects out and never prints the notice. Reason: ident is obsolete (port 113 is closed behind almost every home router), its answer is client-controlled so it cannot support bans, and the outbound lookup is a security and privacy surface. Default off in C (src/config.c:283). The C-side red run stays retained at /home/zach/Archives/darkpawns/oracle-runs/2026-11-13/flash-l1-ident-1.
Not player-facing: the identd ERROR reply is logged with log() (src/ident.c:197-198); no descriptor write (R5e).
Not player-facing: a malformed identd response is logged with log() (src/ident.c:205-207); no descriptor write (R5e).

Unreachable from the registered surface: banned hosts are already denied at accept (src/comm.c:1570-1576, "Sorry, your site is banned."), so the CON_ASKNAME BAN_ALL re-check fires only if a host becomes banned between accept and the name prompt (a race no deterministic scenario can drive) or through an ident-qualified user@host match, which needs a live identd on port 113 that the registered environment never has. The message itself is a mudlog to immortals, not a descriptor write (R5e).
